subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this generic readiness contract now, including the `gateway.readiness` configuration identities and public `registerReadinessCriterion` Plugin SDK method?
rationale: The patch is technically credible, but neither tests nor runtime proof can decide whether these permanent operator and plugin contracts are the product surface maintainers want to support.

options.title: Approve and rebase
options.body: Approve the contract, move its SDK types into current plugin leaf modules, rebase onto current `main`, and rerun exact-head runtime and upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow to core readiness
options.body: Land only canonical core readiness and the CLI projection while deferring plugin-contributed criteria and selector configuration.

options.title: Defer to the RFC
options.body: Pause this PR until the readiness RFC records the permanent condition, configuration, and plugin API contracts.

recommendation.title: Approve and rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the contract, move its SDK types into current plugin leaf modules, rebase onto current `main`, and rerun exact-head runtime and upgrade proof.
